Statement boundaries written back as the source wrote them (issue
01a16602-6030). A dereference keeps the braces the source put around its
operand (Node.DerefBraces); an anonymous sub standing as a statement keeps
its `;`; a keyword after goto, last, next or redo begins the operand rather
than naming a label, and the operand runs through an assignment; a bare
block with a continue block is a block form; the file's last statement keeps
the source's missing `;`; and a heredoc body the source put before closers
stays before them. None is forgiven by Faithful. Each Deparse,-p is perl
5.44.0's.

=== a hash slice through braces (op/avhv.t)
my $avhv; my @x = delete @{$avhv}{'foo','pants'};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== a scalar deref in braces (op/gv.t, uni/gv.t)
my $a; ok(!defined ${$a});
--- facts
faithful

=== a key/value array slice through braces (op/kvaslice.t)
my $a; my $s = join(':', %{$a}[2,3,4]);
--- facts
faithful

=== a key/value hash slice through braces (op/kvhslice.t)
my $h; my $s = join(':', %{$h}{'c','d','e'});
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== local of a braced scalar deref (op/localref.t)
my $x; { local ${$x}; }
--- facts
faithful

=== a braced scalar deref subscripted (op/postfixderef.t)
my $h; is(${$h}{ppp}, 'pp');
--- facts
faithful

=== an array slice through braces (op/ref.t)
my $name1; my (undef, $one) = @{$name1}[2,3];
--- facts
faithful

=== an array slice of $_ through braces (uni/fold.t)
my @a = @{$_}[1,2];
--- facts
faithful

=== a braced scalar deref with two subscripts (30a8)
my $h; my $x = ${$h}{a}{b};
--- facts
faithful

=== a hash slice of qw through braces (30a8)
my $h; my @x = @{$h}{qw(a b)};
--- facts
rv2hv 1 exact
faithful

=== a whole array through braces
my $r; my @x = @{$r};
--- facts
faithful
# (my(@x) = @{$r;}); `my @x = @$r` is (my(@x) = @$r)

=== a scalar deref as the operand of another (op/gv.t, uni/gv.t)
sub FETCH { $${$_[0]}; }
--- facts
faithful

=== braces around a non-plain operand stay
my $a; my $v = ${$a->[0]};
--- facts
faithful

=== an anonymous sub statement in a block (op/closure.t)
sub bizz { if (@_) { my $i = shift; sub { $i = shift if @_; $i; }; } }
--- facts
faithful

=== an anonymous sub with a prototype as a statement (op/const-optree.t)
my $s = sub { sub () { $x; }; };
--- facts
faithful

=== an anonymous sub as a do block's last statement (op/stash.t, uni/stash.t)
my $sub = do { package four; sub { 1; }; };
--- facts
faithful

=== an anonymous sub statement at file level
sub { 1; };
print 2;
--- facts
faithful
# sub { 1; } ; print(2);   `sub {1} print 2` is a syntax error

=== goto an anonymous sub (op/goto-sub.t)
sub f1 { my $x; goto sub { $x = 0; ok(1); }; }
--- facts
faithful
# sub f1 { my($x); (goto (sub { ($x = 0); ok(1); })); }

=== goto an anonymous sub in a sort block (op/sort.t)
my @output = sort { goto sub { 1; }; } 1, 2;
--- facts
faithful

=== goto a state assignment (op/state.t)
use feature 'state'; foreach my $f (1) { goto state $flower = $f; }
--- facts
faithful

=== goto an assignment
sub f2 { my $x; goto $x = 1; }
--- facts
faithful

=== last with a variable label (op/loopctl.t)
L: { my $l = 'L'; eval { last $l; }; }
--- facts
faithful
# L: { (my($l) = 'L'); eval { do { (last $l) } }; }

=== next, redo and last with expressions
for my $x (1) { next $x . 'a'; redo $x if 0; last shift; }
--- facts
faithful

=== a bare block with a continue block, then a statement (op/goto.t)
my $ok; { goto A; A: $ok = 1; } continue { } ok($ok);
--- facts
faithful

=== a bare block with a continue block, then a call (op/while.t, op/loopctl.t)
my ($got_l, $l); { my $l = 0; } continue { $got_l = $l; } is($got_l, 18);
--- facts
faithful

=== a file's last statement without a semicolon (lib/universal.t)

faithful

body
A

=== next before a when modifier (op/switch.t)
use feature 'switch'; no warnings; for (1) { next when 2; last if 1; }
--- facts
faithful
# foreach $_ (1) { when (2) { (next); } (last); }

line two

faithful
